field_checks.changes: If a validated operator model using as-built impedances and live 22:08 flows shows a current fall on LAN-WEH instead of the modelled 52 A rise, the 'no relief' conclusion would change; the size of the rise and the outage margins would also change.
field_checks.item: Actual line impedances and live flows around Landesbergen at the switching time (LAN-WEH, LAN-OVE 1/2, LAN-DOL 1/2, LAN-GRO 1/2) — the reduced model uses reconstructed typical impedances
field_checks.where: Control-room state estimator and network records at Landesbergen, Wehrendorf and Ovenstädt for 22:00–22:10

field_checks.changes: If coupled short-circuit duty exceeds the switchgear rating, coupling is not permissible regardless of the flow result; the load-flow answer alone must not be used to authorise the switch.
field_checks.item: Short-circuit duty at Landesbergen with busbars coupled, against the switchgear rating — data sheet notes separated operation is the normal configuration to keep short-circuit current within rating (report p.15), and this is not checked by the load-flow model
field_checks.where: Landesbergen substation rating documentation and a short-circuit study for the coupled configuration

headline: No relief — coupling raises line current

highlights.text: Coupling raises current from 1,779 A (run 'LAN 22:00 base coupler open') to 1,831 A (run 'LAN coupled coupler closed'), past the 1,795 A Wehrendorf warning in the data sheet protection table.
Closing gives the opposite of the expected 80 A fall noted in the data sheet 'Operating request at 22:08'; do not use it as a relief measure on this evidence.
If LAN-WEH trips after coupling, this 220 kV line reaches 1,646 A against its 1,000 A thermal rating in the single-outage screen on 'LAN coupled coupler closed'.
Single-outage screen after coupling is not secure: 8 cases exceed limits, worst 3,626 A on LAN-WEH with Ovenstädt–Bechterdissen out (limit 2,100 A).

summary: On the rebuilt reduced model, closing the Landesbergen coupler raises the Wehrendorf line from 1,779 amps (run 'LAN 22:00 base coupler open') to 1,831 amps (run 'LAN coupled coupler closed') — the opposite of relief, and past the 1,795 amp warning in the data sheet protection table. The single-outage screen on the coupled run is not secure, with 8 outage cases over limits; because the network impedances are reconstructed rather than reported, treat the exact numbers as provisional pending the checks below.
request: Dispatchers plan to couple the busbars at Landesbergen to relieve the Landesbergen-Wehrendorf line. Will it relieve the line, and is the grid N-1 secure afterwards?
